Method of Attack: Banking trojan designed to steal credentials and browser history
Download and install new apps in adware-like schemes
Gains root access and infects the Android OS Zygote core process allowing unrestricted actions
Impacted Systems: Low-cost Android smartphones such as Leagoo M5 Plus, Leagoo M8, Nomu S10, Nomu S20
Attack Vector: Preinstalled malware in firmware via supply chain compromise
